newsitem.title: UK: UK shares start mixed to higher, eye bond market.
newsitem.headline: UK shares start mixed to higher, eye bond market.

text.p: UK shares opened mixed to moderately higher on Friday but end-of-week trading volumes were light as investors kept a close watch on European bond markets ahead of Sunday's French elections.
The FTSE 100 index was up 7.1 points to 4,679.4 by 0735 GMT, helped by a firmer bond market and the upcoming flotation of the Halifax Building Society, dealers said.
"Thre hasn't been a lot of early buying. This is just market makers pushing prices up ahead of the Halifax float," the head of sales and trading at a large brokerage said.
"The key today will be how the bonds perform."
